GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
